```{=typst}
#let mk(n) = box(baseline: 22%, circle(radius: 5.8pt, fill: rgb("#d9480f"), stroke: none, inset: 0pt)[#set align(center + horizon); #text(fill: white, weight: "bold", size: 8pt)[#n]])
#let tick = box(baseline: 12%, width: 10pt, height: 10pt, stroke: 0.9pt + luma(70), radius: 2pt)
#let shot(path, w: 100%) = block(breakable: false, stroke: 0.8pt + luma(150), radius: 6pt, clip: true, image(path, width: w))
#let typebox(body) = block(width: 100%, breakable: false, fill: rgb("#f1f6fd"), stroke: 0.8pt + rgb("#185abd"), radius: 5pt, inset: (x: 12pt, y: 9pt), body)
#let tip(body) = block(width: 100%, breakable: false, fill: rgb("#fff4e6"), stroke: (left: 3pt + rgb("#d9480f")), inset: (x: 10pt, y: 7pt), radius: 3pt, body)
// One step: the box to tick, its number and what to do on the left; its screen on the right.
#let step(n, body, img: none, w: 100%, left: 40%, after: none) = block(breakable: false, above: 9pt, below: 9pt, width: 100%)[
  #set par(justify: false, leading: 0.62em)
  #let words = grid(columns: (auto, 1fr), column-gutter: 6pt, [#tick #h(1pt) *#n.*], body)
  #if img == none { words } else {
    grid(columns: (left, 1fr), column-gutter: 12pt, align: (top, top), words, align(center, shot(img, w: w)))
  }
  #if after != none { v(4pt); after }
]
```

::: {.lead}
Today you make a short talk in **PowerPoint** on the lab computer: two
slides about the college book fair. Do the tasks in order. The **orange
numbers** in each picture show where to click. Tick the box
`#tick`{=typst} after each step. Stuck? Raise your hand.
:::

- **You need:** a lab computer with PowerPoint. **Nothing to download:**
  you type the text yourself.
- **Time:** about 35 minutes. Your PowerPoint may look a little different:
  the names of the buttons are the same.

## Task 1 · Open PowerPoint and make the first slide

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Click *Search* on the taskbar #mk(1). Type *powerpoint*. Click *PowerPoint* #mk(2).], img: "images/lab-open-1.png", w: 80%, left: 32%)
#step(2, [Click *Blank Presentation* #mk(1).], img: "images/lab-open-2.png", w: 36%, left: 32%)
#step(3, [Click in *Click to add title* #mk(1) and type: #h(3pt) #box(fill: white, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#185abd"), radius: 4pt, inset: 4pt)[Our Book Fair] \ Click in *Click to add subtitle* #mk(2) and type: #h(3pt) #box(fill: white, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#185abd"), radius: 4pt, inset: 4pt)[Sunrise College · Sunday to Tuesday]], img: "images/lab-title-1.png", w: 100%, left: 42%)
```

```{=typst}
#pagebreak(weak: true)
```

## Task 2 · A slide of points, and the notes

A slide has **few words**: 3 to 5 short points. What you **say** goes in
the **notes** under the slide.

```{=typst}
#step(1, [On the *Home* tab, click the small arrow of *New Slide* #mk(1). \ Click *Title and Content* #mk(2).], img: "images/lab-newslide-1.png", w: 82%, left: 36%)
#step(2, [Click in *Click to add title* #mk(1) and type: #box(fill: white, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#185abd"), radius: 4pt, inset: 4pt)[When and where] \ Click in *Click to add text* #mk(2) and type three points. Press *Enter* after each one: \ #box(fill: white, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#185abd"), radius: 4pt, inset: 6pt)[Sunday to Tuesday \ 10:00 to 15:00 \ The college library] \ Click in *Click to add notes* #mk(3) and type: #box(fill: white, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#185abd"), radius: 4pt, inset: 4pt)[Entry is free for everyone.]], after: align(center, shot("images/lab-notes-1.png", w: 86%)))
```

```{=typst}
#pagebreak(weak: true)
```

## Task 3 · A theme for the whole talk

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Click the *Design* tab #mk(1). Click a theme that you like #mk(2). \ Click a *variant* #mk(3): other colours of the same theme. \ Both slides change at once.], after: align(center, shot("images/lab-design-1.png", w: 92%)))
```

## Task 4 · A transition and an animation

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Click the *Transitions* tab #mk(1). Click *Fade* #mk(2). \ Click *Apply To All* #mk(3): every slide fades in.], after: align(center, shot("images/lab-transition-1.png", w: 92%)))
#step(2, [Click slide *2* on the left. Click the list of points #mk(1). \ Click the *Animations* tab #mk(2). Click *Appear* #mk(3).], img: "images/lab-animation-1.png", w: 100%, left: 34%)
#step(3, [Press *F5*: the slide show starts. Click: the points come one by one. Press *Esc* to stop.])
```

```{=typst}
#pagebreak(weak: true)
```

## Task 5 · Save your talk

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Press *F12* (on a laptop: *Fn + F12*). The *Save As* window opens. \ _Or:_ click *File*, *Save As*, *Browse*.])
#step(2, [Click *Desktop* #mk(1). \ In *File name*, type *talk-* and your first name #mk(2). \ Click *Save* #mk(3).], img: "images/lab-save-1.png", w: 94%, left: 32%)
```

## Show your teacher

```{=typst}
#block(breakable: false, grid(columns: (1.1fr, 1fr), column-gutter: 14pt, align: top,
  shot("images/lab-result-1.png"),
  [
    #set par(spacing: 0.9em, justify: false)
    Your talk now looks like the picture. Check it:
    #v(4pt)
    #tick #h(4pt) Slide 1 is a *Title Slide*: Our Book Fair. \
    #tick #h(4pt) Slide 2 has 3 short points, and the notes. \
    #tick #h(4pt) Both slides have the same theme. \
    #tick #h(4pt) F5: the slides fade in, the points come one by one. \
    #tick #h(4pt) The file is on the Desktop.
    #v(8pt)
    #tip[Raise your hand: your teacher looks at your screen. \ Then do the *Extra*: AI adds a slide to your talk.]
  ],
))
```

## Extra · AI adds a slide to your talk

```{=typst}
#block(width: 100%, fill: rgb("#e3f4f1"), stroke: 0.8pt + rgb("#8fd1c4"), radius: 6pt, inset: (x: 12pt, y: 9pt))[

]

#step(2, [Click the box *Drop a file anywhere on this page, or click to choose* #mk(1). \ Click *Desktop*, click your file *talk-…*, click *Open*. \ Your talk opens in the online editor.], img: "images/lab-tutu-1.png", w: 84%, left: 36%)
#step(3, [Click *AI Assistant* at the top #mk(1). \ Click in *Ask AI anything…* #mk(2) and type: #h(3pt) #box(fill: white, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#8fd1c4"), radius: 4pt, inset: 5pt)[Add a slide with 3 short points: what students can bring to the book fair.] \ Press *Enter* #mk(3). Wait about 15 seconds: a new slide comes.], after: align(center, shot("images/lab-tutu-2.png", w: 84%)))
#step(4, [One more request. Type: #h(3pt) #box(fill: white, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#8fd1c4"), radius: 4pt, inset: 5pt)[Make the title of slide 1 dark blue.] \ Press *Enter*. Wait for the answer before you type again.])
#step(5, [Click *File* #mk(1), then *Download* #mk(2), then the choice that ends in *.pptx* #mk(3). \ Open the new file from *Downloads*: it opens in PowerPoint, with the changes of the AI.], img: "images/lab-tutu-3.png", w: 74%, left: 44%)
```
